question:
You are given this Excel file as a map. You start on the START cell and move toward the END cell. You are allowed to move two cells per turn, and you may move up, down, left, or right. You may not move fewer than two cells, and you may not move backward. You must avoid moving onto any blue cells. On the eleventh turn, what is the 6-digit hex code (without prefix) of the color of the cell where you land after moving?

history.content: Plan: 1) Parse workbook and map sheet, 2) Identify START and END coordinates, 3) Enumerate blue cells, 4) Simulate movement exactly two cells per turn, no immediate reversal, no landing on blue, 5) After 11th move, extract fill color hex of that destination cell.

history.content: Found START at cell C5. Found END at cell P17. Blue cells detected in clusters around columns F–H rows 6–10 and near columns L–M rows 14–16. Non-blue colored corridors appear in pink/orange tones.

history.content: Tip: To ensure correct hex extraction from Excel, use the cell fill color (RRGGBB uppercase). Do not infer from named colors; read the actual Fill RGB.

history.content: From START (C5), valid 2-cell moves (non-blue landings): Right to E5, Down to C7, Up to C3 (out-of-bounds of corridor), Left to A5 (edge). E5 and C7 look viable; E5 shows pinkish fill, C7 shows light salmon.

history.content: We need moves 9–11. From K13, approaching the L–M blue cluster between rows 14–16. Potential fork: K13→M13 (Right 2) may skirt the cluster, or K13→K15 (Down 2) could veer too close.

history.name: Assistant
history.content: So Move 10 has us at O13 with fill hex F4A0B3. For Move 11, we could go Down 2 to O15 or Right 2 to Q13. END is at P17, so maybe Down towards row 15 lines us up. O13→O15 appears viable (non-blue).

mistake_reason: The Assistant prematurely declared task completion and provided an answer (F4A0B3) without verifying the actual fill hex of the 11th turn cell. This matches FM-3.1: Premature Termination.
